help: Recompute the journals from the book's current inputs in memory and compare them with the stored journals. Read-only.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.help: Differences to list (1-200); counts always cover every row

help: Write a fresh copy of the bundled demo book into a new directory under PATH, remove earlier demo copies there, and build its local analysis index. Contacts nothing; the book has no sync backend.

arguments.name: path
arguments.help: Directory that holds demo copies; defaults to demo/ under the state root

help: Show every setting of a book and the choices its country allows: method, pool scope, currency, holding period, tax year start, time zone, pricing and rail defaults. Read-only.
Change any setting of a book, validated against its country; --dry-run shows what would change first. A change the journals read invalidates them, as profiles set does.

arguments.name: fiat_currency
arguments.help: The book's ISO 4217 currency (a country with its own currency fixes it)

arguments.name: tax_country
arguments.help: Tax country for the book (CLI profile; currently supported: generic, at)

arguments.name: tax_long_term_days
arguments.help: Days held for a long-term gain (countries whose holding period is a day count)

arguments.name: gains_algorithm
arguments.help: Accounting method; the country decides which (see profiles settings)

arguments.name: tax_year_start
arguments.help: The tax year's first day: MM-DD (not 02-29) or calendar, uk, april, july, march; default for the country's. Only where the country lets a book choose

arguments.name: timezone
arguments.help: The IANA zone whose local dates cut the book's tax years and report periods; default for the country's. Only zones the country allows

arguments.name: bitcoin_rail_carrying_value
arguments.help: Default BTC/LBTC rail-change suggestions to carrying-value treatment.

arguments.name: require_coarse_review
arguments.help: Quarantine coarse (daily/monthly) priced events for manual review instead of accepting them at the coarse spot price.

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.help: Show what the change would do (fields, journals to reprocess, rows a currency change holds, readiness effects) without applying it

help: Write an encrypted replay bundle of the book's journal inputs and outputs

arguments.name: file
arguments.help: Destination `.kassiber-replay` file path (separate from the global --output)

arguments.name: bundle_passphrase_fd
arguments.help: Read the bundle passphrase from this open file descriptor

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.help: Confirm the bundle holds exact amounts, dates, rates and tax settings of this book

help: Re-run a replay bundle's journals and diff them against its recorded outputs

arguments.help: Read the bundle passphrase from this open file descriptor
